title: WikiTusks
tagline: Censorship-resistant, crowdsourced, decentralized Wiki built on Walrus
description:
By leveraging Walrus's decentralized storage protocol on the Sui blockchain, this lets users easily, through WYSIWYG editor, share articles in a permissionless and censorship-resistant way.

Walrus ensures that content is stored across a trustless network, making it virtually impossible for any single entity—be it a government, ISP, or a platform—to censor or erase information. 

This project aligns with the vision of Web3, where users control their data and knowledge is preserved without gatekeepers. It addresses real-world challenges like information suppression and data vulnerability while promoting transparency and community governance.
how_its_made:
- Each submitted article is stored in Walrus network
- Static frontend is built with React and deployed to Netlify
- Articles are uploaded and read via Walrus's HTTP API
- A ledger of all submitted articles is stored in a JSONBin database. A real solution could include smart contract or a Walrus Site tracking submitted articles
